{"path":"todo_openrouter-minimax-minimax-m3_01.html","edit_description":"Create a single self-contained HTML file containing a Todo app with the following requirements:
- Add new todos via input + button (or Enter key)
- Mark todos as complete (toggle strikethrough on the text)
- Delete todos (with a delete button per item)
- Filter: All / Active / Completed (three filter buttons that show/hide items accordingly; one should be visually active)
- Persist to localStorage (load on init, save on every change)

The file must be fully self-contained: inline <style> for CSS and inline <script> for JS. No external dependencies, no CDN links.

Design guidance:
- Clean, modern look. Centered card on a soft background.
- Use a nice font stack (system fonts), good spacing, rounded corners, subtle shadows.
- Checkbox-style toggle for completion. Completed items show strikethrough text and slightly faded color.
- Each todo row: checkbox on left, text in middle, delete button (×) on right.
- Bottom bar with item count ("X items left") and the three filter buttons; include a "Clear completed" button when there are completed items.
- Empty state: friendly message when no todos match the current filter.
- Keyboard: Enter in the input adds a todo; clicking the checkbox toggles; clicking × deletes.
- IDs/timestamps not required, but each todo should have a stable id (e.g., Date.now() + random) so localStorage round-trips cleanly.
- Escape HTML in todo text to prevent injection from localStorage.

Keep the file reasonably compact but well-organized. Use vanilla JS only."}
